# AgriFarmers

> Precision Agriculture & Smart Farming Companion for Indian farmers. Real-time crop diagnosis, mandi rates, soil health analysis, and weather advisory in 13 regional languages.

## Project Summary
AgriFarmers empowers Indian farmers with:
- AI Crop Doctor for leaf disease identification
- ICAR Precision Fertilizer Calculator & Soil Health Prescriptions
- Geospatial Facility Map for KVKs, Soil Testing Labs, and APMC Mandis
- Smart Evapotranspiration (ET0) Irrigation Planning with 7-day water scheduling
- Multi-lingual support across 13 Indian native languages

## Canonical Links
